notes.title: Multiplayer & Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Hey friends, the [b]Cooperative Mode[/b] is released![/h2]

[h3]Call all your friends and acquaintances, go from poor Russians to Foreign Agents together!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544876/6ad303f3b1c3f1efc3183b1fbee5cbf9643a4a73.png[/img]

[h3]Also we released a [b]Big Hotfix Patch[/b], it was fixed a huge number of small bugs.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544876/327a6c37cb0734039d3ab3e8f39a5b13d56b2fd8.png[/img]

[h3][b]Vladimir Putin[/b] and [b]Joe Biden[/b] look forward to seeing [b]you [/b]and[b] your friends[/b] in the game![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544876/63281d179cba306d9d1af2ac22e0fc2896efefcb.png[/img]

[h3][b]Thank you![/b][/h3]
